title: SAP Recognized as a Leader in the Inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Workforce Management Technology
summary: SAP was named a Leader in the inaugural Gartner Magic Quadrant for Workforce Management Technology. Learn more about this recognition.
body_markdown:
Organizations today face growing pressure to navigate labor shortages, evolving employee expectations, changing skills requirements, and increasing operational complexity. As these challenges converge—across factory floors, service centers, project teams, and global operations—workforce management is becoming more than an operational necessity. It’s becoming a strategic foundation for workforce transformation. Gartner predicts that by 2030, 70% of organizations will adopt AI-enabled workforce management technology to decrease managers’ administrative workload by an average of four to six hours per week, optimize operations, and enhance employee experience.


That’s why we’re proud that SAP has been recognized as a Leader in the inaugural **Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Workforce Management Technology** .


We believe this recognition reflects SAP’s commitment to helping organizations connect workforce operations, workforce intelligence, and business outcomes through a unified human capital management (HCM) platform.


This graphic was published by Gartner, Inc. as part of a larger research document and should be evaluated in the context of the entire document. The Gartner document is available upon request from[www.sap.com/products/hcm/workforce-management.html](https://www.sap.com/products/hcm/workforce-management.html?campaigncode=CRM-YD26-HXM-679328&url_id=gartner-mq-2026-wfm&rc=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gartner.com%2Freprints%2F%3Fid%3D00ThR00000GbvWXUAZ%26ct%3D260918%26st%3Dsb) .


## **Workforce management in the era of Autonomous HCM**


As organizations prepare for the next era of work, leaders need more than scheduling tools and time systems. They need a connected understanding of their workforce.


*Who is available? What skills are needed? Where are emerging labor gaps? How can workforce decisions better support business priorities?*


These questions sit at the intersection of workforce management and workforce strategy.


That’s why workforce management plays an important role in SAP’s vision for[Autonomous HCM](https://www.sap.com/products/hcm.html) . At its core, Autonomous HCM is about helping organizations move more quickly from workforce insight to action.


Workforce management plays a critical role in that vision by providing the operational data and workforce visibility needed to make more informed decisions.


By bringing workforce management together with core HR, payroll, talent management, and workforce planning, SAP SuccessFactors solutions help organizations gain a more connected view of their workforce, streamline operations, and make more informed workforce decisions.


Simplify and enhance your everyday workforce operations with SAP SuccessFactors solutions


[Learn more](https://www.sap.com/products/hcm/workforce-management.html)


## **Advancing workforce management**


SAP continues to invest in capabilities that help organizations connect scheduling, absence management, time and attendance, workforce planning, and workforce decision-making. Recent innovations include the general availability of[SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Scheduling](https://www.sap.com/products/hcm/workforce-scheduling.html) , helping manufacturing and production organizations align labor demand, workforce availability, employee skills, and compliance requirements within a more connected scheduling experience.


We also recently introduced a new[Workforce Management Assistant](https://www.sap.com/use-cases/joule-assistant/workforce-management-ai) , which helps employees and managers complete common workforce management tasks—like automatically pre-filling time sheets, validating entries against compliance requirements in real time, and answering policy questions—cutting employee time sheet completion effort by up to 40% and HR service tickets by up to 20%.


For professional services organizations, this focus on streamlining time extends further. The new consolidated timesheet experience across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and SAP SuccessFactors Time Tracking helps unify project time and HR attendance in a single flow from resource planning to revenue recognition.


From frontline workers on the production floor to project professionals, these capabilities reflect SAP’s commitment to industry-specific depth in workforce management.


Beyond workforce operations, SAP recently introduced new workforce planning capabilities within[SAP Enterprise Planning](https://www.sap.com/products/financial-management/enterprise-planning.html) , helping leaders connect workforce decisions directly to HR, business, and financial priorities through a unified planning foundation.


In addition, AI-enabled organizational modeling capabilities can support scenario planning and impact analysis, enabling business and HR leaders to evaluate organizational changes and workforce decisions before they are implemented.


Together, these innovations help organizations connect workforce operations, workforce planning, and workforce decisions in new ways, supporting SAP’s broader vision for Autonomous HCM.


## **Delivering meaningful outcomes**


Organizations across more than 126 countries and 29 industries are using SAP SuccessFactors workforce management solutions to help improve workforce visibility, streamline time and scheduling processes, strengthen compliance, and create better experiences for employees and managers.


[Eurobank](https://www.sap.com/asset/dynamic/2024/11/0a44cb1b-e27e-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html) deployed SAP SuccessFactors Time Tracking to comply with new labor regulations requiring detailed workforce scheduling and time management. The organization achieved 99% clock-in and clock-out compliance, reduced neglected clock-outs by 44%, and decreased data-uploading errors by 25%, helping improve workforce visibility, compliance, and operational efficiency.


[Ocean Network Express (ONE)](https://www.sap.com/asset/dynamic/2025/07/98c91dd3-147f-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html) implemented SAP SuccessFactors Time Tracking, SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, and payroll solutions to support a global workforce of 10,000 employees. By automating time management, overtime calculations, and payroll processes, the company achieved 40% operational savings, improved compliance, and delivered greater flexibility across HR and workforce operations.


These examples illustrate how workforce management is becoming a strategic capability that helps organizations connect workforce operations with broader business priorities.


## **Looking ahead**


We believe our recognition as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Workforce Management Technology reflects SAP’s continued investment in helping organizations build more connected, agile, and resilient workforces—and the trust of our customers, partners, and teams whose collaboration and innovation help shape what’s next.


With many organizations actively reviewing their workforce management technology, there’s never been a better time to see what SAP can offer.


**Discover why SAP is recognized as a Leader in**[the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Workforce Management Technology](https://www.sap.com/products/hcm/workforce-management.html?campaigncode=CRM-YD26-HXM-679328&url_id=gartner-mq-2026-wfm&rc=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gartner.com%2Freprints%2F%3Fid%3D00ThR00000GbvWXUAZ%26ct%3D260918%26st%3Dsb) **and learn more about**[SAP SuccessFactors workforce management solutions](https://www.sap.com/products/hcm/workforce-management.html) .
